About the Artists

Two Artists, One Vision
for the Bride

Ashika & Ashifa are Chennai-based bridal makeup artists devoted to a single craft: making a bride look and feel entirely like herself, only more radiant. From the first consultation to the last pin in the drape, every detail is considered.

  • Bridal makeup, from soft dewy looks to full HD glam
  • Hair styling for every ritual, reception and after-party
  • Saree & dupatta draping in traditional and contemporary styles
  • Traditional Tamil bridal looks alongside modern editorial finishes
  • Destination wedding styling across India and beyond

What We Offer

Our Bridal Services

Every service tailored to the bride, the occasion and the story of the day.

✦

Bridal Makeup

HD and airbrush finishes crafted for the wedding day, long-lasting through every ritual.

✦

Engagement Makeup

Soft, luminous looks designed for the ring ceremony and pre-wedding celebrations.

✦

Reception Makeup

Bold, camera-ready glam for the reception evening and every photograph after.

✦

Hair Styling

Classic buns, braids and modern styles finished with fresh flowers or heirloom jewellery.

✦

Saree Draping

Traditional Kanjivaram and contemporary drapes, pleated to perfection and pinned to last.

✦

Mehendi & Bridal Styling

Coordinated styling for the mehendi ceremony, from outfit draping to festive hair and glow.

✦

Groom Styling

Grooming, hair styling and finishing touches so the groom is just as ready for the day.

✦

Destination Wedding Makeup

We travel with the bride — full styling coverage for weddings beyond Chennai.
